models.label: Real age
models.question: How old this person actually is
models.explanation: Trained on 25,080 photos with real chronological ages (AgeDB, APPA-REAL, FG-NET). Typical error about 6.4 years against a person's actual age.

checkpoint.real_age_corpus: AgeDB + APPA-REAL + FG-NET held-out test, n=3807
checkpoint.accuracy_note: real_age_mae is the error against real chronological age, measured end to end through this server's detect-crop-decode path. This model never saw UTKFace, so there is no in-corpus DEX figure and none should be invented for it.

interval_calibration.corpus: AgeDB + APPA-REAL + FG-NET held-out test, n=3807
interval_calibration.note: The low/high interval is nominally 68% (the 0.16/0.84 quantiles) but covers about 61% on this corpus. The shortfall is a property of the construction and corpus, not of either checkpoint -- the two models differ by 0.9pp. Not retuned, because tuning it to the split it is measured on would be fitting the evaluation set.
